public_rationale: The June 2025 statement supports the narrower concern that the venture was still being formed. It cannot establish that no entity existed by April 2026. The construction disclosure addresses a different question and does not settle legal formation. Neither record establishes that the original announcement was knowingly false.
limitations: The formation statement is available through a third-party transcript.
Construction and legal formation must not be conflated.
The allegation of deception remains separately unproven.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The $500B Stargate project was a lie; the entity was never formed.

statement.excerpt: Stargate was a lie! The whole time it was a lie! That time that Sam Altman and Masayoshi Son and Larry Ellison stood up at the white house and talked about a $500 billion infrastructure project was a lie! They never formed the entity!

our_interpretation: The concrete factual assertion is that the announced joint-venture legal entity had not been formed by publication.
The period runs from the January 2025 announcement through the post date because never and the whole time describe that history.
Formation, capitalization, and construction under the Stargate name are different facts.
The $500 billion figure identifies the announced venture; this assessment does not treat it as a claim that this amount had already been spent.
Calling the announcement a lie additionally alleges knowing misrepresentation. Delay or nonformation alone cannot establish that intent.
criteria.support_condition: Corporate records or authoritative participant documentation establish nonformation through April 8, 2026. Supporting the allegation of a lie additionally requires evidence that the relevant announcement was knowingly false.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Authenticated records establish formation of the announced venture by April 8, 2026. Evidence of real construction alone does not contradict the narrower legal-entity assertion.
